pages.text: Two blocks long. Ride a host onto the belt and get off with $(k:key.sneak): "Clocked in." It walks in place: 4 to 24 FE/t by species (a cow 10, a camel 24, anything unlisted 8).

It holds 10 kFE and pushes up to 1,000 FE/t from its near end into touching machines, as the Galvanic Pile does. A body on the belt rots twice as fast (embalmed: at the usual rate). A laced body is $(l)Tired$(): half output, forever. Full sync: +10%%.

Ridden, it makes power too, and forward goes nowhere. Use it with an empty hand to read it. Fliers, swimmers, ghasts, striders, slimes, shells and the heavy ones (golems, ravagers, wardens, hoglins) refuse.$(br2)$(o)A healthy body is a productive body.$()
